title: Quarterly Private Governance Playbook and Release Contingency Plan
creator: Amara Chen
description: Create an operational governance playbook and release contingency plan for Private (VPC/on‑prem) deployments. The playbook will standardize pre-release gating (compatibility, security, compliance), runtime and network controls, and a clear set of automated and manual rollback/mitigation actions tied to signals from Console observability and dedicated on‑prem health checks. Objective is to reduce mean time to remediation for private rollouts and ensure predictable SLAs for enterprise customers.
objectives: Define a repeatable governance checklist that covers RBAC, KMS/HSM key rotation, audit logging retention, and upgrade compatibility
Establish metric-based contingency triggers (latency P95, error rate, KV cache miss increase, failed autoscale events) and map them to automated fallbacks and manual runbooks
Reduce private-deploy rollback time by 40% vs current baseline and cut customer-impacting incidents during rollout windows to near-zero
Deliver playbook artifacts (Confluence runbook, Console dashboards, GitHub emergency PR templates) and train solutions/SEs
acceptance_criteria: Governance checklist validated by security and compliance (signed review) and stored in Confluence
Contingency triggers implemented in Console alerting (thresholds and on-call routing) and testable via synthetic load
Rollback automation scripts and one-click downgrade path verified in staging and runbook documented
Customer-facing upgrade notes and compatibility matrix published for top-10 enterprise customers
Cross-functional tabletop exercise completed with SRE, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product
rollout_plan: Week 1: Draft governance checklist and map to existing private deployment runbooks
Week 2: Collaborate with Security to finalize KMS/HSM key rotation and audit logging retention requirements
Week 3: Implement alerting thresholds in Console and wire to on-call playbooks; create synthetic tests for triggers
Week 4: Build rollback automation scripts (eng) and document manual fallback steps (ops)
Week 5: Run tabletop exercise and incorporate feedback; publish Confluence playbook and notify SE/customer success
Week 6: Pilot playbook during scheduled private deployment to 2 enterprise cohorts and collect telemetry
contingency_triggers: SLO breach: private-rt-p95 > SLO for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows
Error spike: 5x baseline request error rate within 5 minutes
KV cache miss ratio increase > 30% affecting token cost and latency
Autoscale failures: unable to provision dedicated nodes within configured burst window
Security anomaly: unauthorized API access attempt detected or KMS key rotation failure
mitigation_actions: Automated: route traffic to regional hosted fallback model variant via smart routing policy
Automated: enable prefix/KV cache bypass or conservative batching to stabilize latency
Manual: initiate one-click rollback to previous model runtime image and pinned model version
Manual: escalate to Incident Lead, pause rollout waves, and open dedicated Slack war room channel
Customer communication: trigger templated status email and SE outreach; apply temporary commitment credits if SLA impacted
